verdict.rationale: Workable's ReadMe-hosted API reference has the "Try It!" request runner and SDK code snippets enabled, so users can explore endpoints and run requests from the docs. The runner only executes against the caller's real live account with a Bearer token. No test base URL, test keys or sandbox tenant is documented, and the OpenAPI spec download is explicitly disabled. That makes safe exploration a documented limitation. Missing for 10: sandbox or test environment for runnable examples, a downloadable machine-readable spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the runner.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
